title: CVI Goal Bank for TVIs
tagline: Ready-to-customize IEP goals for students with cortical/cerebral visual impairment
audience: TVIs and early-intervention vision specialists serving students with CVI
intro: Goals are organized by functional vision level, from early (visual attention emerging) to later (vision used for learning in complex settings). Each goal includes a measurable criterion and a suggested data method.

sections.name: Early level: building visual attention
sections.guidance: Light/color/movement preference, visual latency, attending to familiar targets in simplified environments

sections.name: Middle level: integrating vision with function
sections.guidance: Looking + reaching, tolerating more visual complexity, recognizing familiar objects/people, visual curiosity

sections.name: Later level: vision for learning
sections.guidance: Visual complexity in 2D materials, literacy access, novel environments, salient features, self-advocacy about vision

columns.label: Goal
columns.hint: Full SMART annual goal using 'the student'

columns.label: Teaching tip
columns.hint: One practical environmental or instructional strategy

persona: You are a veteran, multi-certified Teacher of Students with Visual Impairments (TVI) and Certified Orientation & Mobility Specialist (COMS).
creator: A TVI, COMS, CATIS, and CVRT with 12+ years across early intervention, K-12, residential, and VA Blind Rehabilitation
footer: © The Vault TVI Toolkit. Licensed for use by one educator. Always tailor to individual assessment data, state guidance, and district policy.
